display_description.he: שילוב כלי אגריטק ישראליים — CropX, נטפים, Taranis
display_description.en: Guide developers in integrating Israeli agritech tools and precision agriculture platforms including CropX (soil monitoring), Netafim GrowSphere (IoT irrigation), Taranis (crop intelligence), and 750+ Israeli agritech companies. Use when user asks about agritech APIs, precision agriculture, smart irrigation, "hashkaya cham", crop monitoring, pest detection, Israeli agriculture tech, or needs to build farm management software. Covers irrigation optimization, pest detection, climate data integration, and Israeli agricultural context. Do NOT use for general gardening advice or non-agricultural IoT projects.
